title: Shifted single comparison for restricted derived section pullback
statement: Let $S,Y,Y'$ be schemes, $a:Y'\to Y$, $h:Y\to S$, $h':Y'\to S$, $a\gg h=h'$, $U\to S$ etale, and $p\in\mathbb N$. Let $F,F'$ be abelian etale sheaves and $\phi:a^*F\to F'$. Let $\tau:T_h\to D^+(a^*)\,T_{h'}$ be the explicitly constructed natural transformation of [lem-sbc-restricted-derived-section-zero-comparison]. Let $s_{h,F}:T_h(F[0][p])\cong H^p(U\times_S Y,r^*F)$ be the shift comparison [def-sbc-raw-restricted-cohomology-comparison-map]. Put $\beta=\mathrm{commShift}_{D^+(a^*),p}.\mathrm{hom}_{F[0]}\gg(c_F.\mathrm{hom}\gg\phi[0])[p]$, with $c_F$ the exact-pullback single comparison. Then $\tau_{F[0][p]}\gg T_{h'}(\beta)\gg s_{h',F'}.\mathrm{hom}=s_{h,F}.\mathrm{hom}\gg R_{a,\phi}$, where $R_{a,\phi}$ is the explicitly constructed restricted-cohomology map [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology]. There is no source sheaf, derived morphism into $F[0][p]$, or source isomorphism in this assertion.

proof.text: Use the shift-transport identity for the morphism given by the exact inverse-image single comparison followed by the single of phi. This expresses the shifted map as the source shift comparison followed by degree-p homology of the unshifted derived map conjugated by the single comparison.

Apply degree-p homology to restrictedDerivedSections_single. Unfold the explicit restricted-cohomology map, use functoriality of homology and of derived global sections, and associate compositions. The unshifted map is the source single comparison followed by the explicit restricted-cohomology map after homology. Cancel the homology image of the source single comparison with the homology image of its inverse. This proves the required equality.

theorem restrictedSectionPullback_shift {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}}
    (a : Y' ⟶ Y) (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (p : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj F ⟶ F') (U : S.Etale) :
    (restrictedSectionPullback a h h' w U).app
        (((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F)⟦(p : ℤ)⟧) ≫
      (sectionsFunctor ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ h').obj U) ⋙
        DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} 0).map
          ((D+(upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).commShiftIso (p : ℤ)).hom.app
              ((DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).obj F) ≫
            (shiftFunctor _ (p : ℤ)).map
              (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).mapDerivedCategoryPlusSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
                  F ≫ (DerivedCategory.Plus.singleFunctor _ 0).map φ)) ≫
        (shiftIso h' p F' U).hom =
      (shiftIso h p F U).hom ≫ rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap a h h' w p F F' φ U
